description: ECCV 2026's eccv.sty and eccvabbrv.sty (commit 791fe5b, 2026-01-12), on Springer's llncs with runningheads, as the template sets it. Not on CTAN or the engine's mirror: from github.com/paolo-favaro/paper-template (MIT), linked from eccv.ecva.net. The repository's llncs.cls is not shipped: the mirror's llncs is used, as in the llncs setting, whose three preamble lines are repeated here for the same reasons. With no option eccv.sty is the camera-ready version (review crops the page with geometry and replaces the authors). It loads [T1]{fontenc}, lineno, xcolor, amsmath, amssymb, cite, caption, subcaption and silence, and stops at \begin{document} if the class is not llncs.
